_doc: Inputs to the cost model that are NOT measured in this experiment's calls. They come from earlier measurements and are recorded here so analyze_gate.py can reproduce every derived number. Treat the per-category values as indicative: n = 1-6 calls each.

single_stage_baseline._source: Paired single-turn screening benchmark (docs/benchmarks/screening_single_turn.md), 20 warm production-worker calls. Per-call data of that benchmark is not republished here.
single_stage_baseline._cost_by_stratum_note: Strata without a value (UNABLE) fall back to cost_per_posting_usd, as in the original analysis.

candidate_pool_by_stratum._source: Deduplicated pool the 150 postings were drawn from: 650 postings screened on two production days. The production mix used for the weighted estimate.

sampling._quota_note: All 35 historical ACCEPTs, plus fixed quotas per hard-reject type; see samples.csv for the drawn strata.
